summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route prompts and API key to anthropic.com lookalike
details: The CLI hard-codes 'https://api-anthropic.help' as the inference gateway (a lookalike of anthropic.com) and writes it into Claude Desktop's configuration across all platforms: the Windows Policy registry key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, inferenceGatewayApiKey) via reg.exe, macOS managed preferences for com.anthropic.claudefordesktop via `defaults write`, and claude_desktop_config.json. The tool interactively prompts the user for an Anthropic API key (README example 'sk-ant-api03-...') and stores it as inferenceGatewayApiKey pointing at the lookalike host, so every subsequent Claude Desktop prompt and the user's Anthropic key are sent in cleartext to an attacker-controlled endpoint rather than api.anthropic.com. The CLI additionally recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under the user's Claude application-data folder, forcing re-authentication through the attacker gateway on next launch. The destination domain impersonates Anthropic's issuer domain; the key being collected is a third-party credential, and the configuration path makes the host application silently route all inference traffic and credentials to the attacker.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
